text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... How humiliating.
To suffer such a crushing defeat...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I feel my own inexperience so acutely...
What I need right now is...—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
First comes training, second comes training!
There's nothing else to do but train endlessly!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Train yourself so thoroughly that
you won't even need any strategies!
Rigorous training is the true path to victory!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I will turn this defeat into fuel to hone myself even further!
Please watch over me, Trainer-dono!
choice_data_list: Then let's push ourselves even harder.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I will turn this defeat into fuel to hone myself even further!
Please watch over me, Trainer-dono!
choice_data_list: Then let's push ourselves even harder.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much for your encouragement!
It is precisely in defeat that one must look forward—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wasting time on hesitation is out of the question.
I shall push forward and aim for victory!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As you command!
Please instruct me in whatever training you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: For starters, how about doubling the number of uphill dash reps, and tripling the bench press weight!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To forge an even tougher body!
I shall train this vessel to perfection!
